description: Segment tree, fitted joint centres and mesh-to-segment assignment for animating the anatomy mesh set.
method: Ball-joint centres are sphere fits to the articular head. Hinge centres are condyle midpoints. Mesh assignment is by nearest bone vertex; a mesh with a second segment above 15% of its vertices spans that joint and is blended, not snapped.
units: metres, Y-up, same space as the GLBs

jointMethod.shoulder.L: humeral head sphere fit, r=22.8mm rms=1.86mm
jointMethod.hip.L: femoral head sphere fit, r=31.5mm rms=9.55mm
jointMethod.palm.L: metacarpal and phalanx centroid — the palmar contact
jointMethod.fingers.L: MCP row from 4 proximal phalanx base slices
jointMethod.fingersMid.L: PIP row from 4 middle phalanx base slices
jointMethod.fingersTip.L: DIP row from 4 distal phalanx base slices
jointMethod.thumb.L: thumb MCP — proximal phalanx base slice
jointMethod.toes.L: MTP axis from 5 proximal phalanx bases
jointMethod.toetip.L: lowest toe-pad vertices — the ground contact
jointMethod.shoulder.R: humeral head sphere fit, r=22.6mm rms=1.72mm
jointMethod.hip.R: femoral head sphere fit, r=31.0mm rms=9.66mm
jointMethod.palm.R: metacarpal and phalanx centroid — the palmar contact
jointMethod.fingers.R: MCP row from 4 proximal phalanx base slices
jointMethod.fingersMid.R: PIP row from 4 middle phalanx base slices
jointMethod.fingersTip.R: DIP row from 4 distal phalanx base slices
jointMethod.thumb.R: thumb MCP — proximal phalanx base slice
jointMethod.toes.R: MTP axis from 5 proximal phalanx bases
jointMethod.toetip.R: lowest toe-pad vertices — the ground contact
jointMethod.head: atlanto-occipital
